# Ask Linc

> The AI financial reasoning assistant for households planning retirement — decisions-ready answers, not charts.

Ask Linc connects to your financial accounts and answers real questions about retirement, home buying, portfolio risk, and what-if scenarios. Answers use your data, live market conditions, and deterministic calculations you can inspect ("Show the math").

## Pricing

- 1 month free, then $9/month flat — ~98% cheaper than a 1% advisor fee
- Cancel anytime
- See a real answer free in the interactive demo (sample data, no credit card needed): https://asklinc.com/demo

## Who it's for

Households planning retirement and major money decisions who are tired of dashboards. Not for day traders or spreadsheet hobbyists.
